checkPoolAndGetCenterPrice(address).notice: Returns the TWAP-derived sqrt price when the pool has sufficient history, otherwise the         instantaneous slot0 sqrt price. When both are available, reverts if the deviation between         the instantaneous price (from slot0) and the TWAP price exceeds MAX_ALLOWED_DEVIATION,         preventing flash-loan driven price manipulation.
